title: Estate scout check would-sync may mean local stale, not remote missing
summary: check:intelligence-hub-scout-hooks evaluates local disk; verify origin/main hook blobs before opening PRs across the estate.
retrievalQuestions: Why does check:intelligence-hub-scout-hooks show would-sync when GitHub main already has hooks?
